Package swiss.trustbroker.config.dto

Class ContentSecurityPolicies

java.lang.Object
swiss.trustbroker.config.dto.ContentSecurityPolicies
public class ContentSecurityPolicies extends Object
Calculating unsafe-hashes: echo -n 'myscript()' | openssl sha256 -binary | openssl base64 Risks: A thus whitelisted script could be injected in other parts of the page by an attacker. We use this for the scripts generated by libraries (SAML auto-submitting form).
